title: The marathon world record has fallen five and a half minutes since 2003
intro: Men's marathon world record, time in seconds — lower is faster. Sabastian Sawe's 1:59:30 in London (2026) is the first sub-two-hour mark in a record-eligible race.

source.name: World Athletics; Wikipedia — Marathon world record progression

altInsight: The men's marathon world record fell from 2:04:55 (7,495 s) in 2003 to 1:59:30 (7,170 s) in 2026, a drop of five minutes and 25 seconds, with the pace of improvement accelerating after 2018.
